paragraphs.source_en: Against whom? Against whom? Is this not thunder in the blue sky? Lock it. Bolt it shut. By tomorrow, dust will already be piled up on the porcelain flower-and-tile floor. Do not admire how smooth and glossy these white stone steps look; by tomorrow, ah, in the joints grass has grown, and over the stone slabs a green mould has spread everywhere. Under the arcade, in a jade-blue jar, true-tail fish are being kept, yet who is there to change their water, who to clear the weeds, and who to feed them? In three or five days at most, they will begin to turn belly up with bulging white bellies and swollen eyes. If they do not die floating on the surface, at least let the ice-cold crust crush them flat. Most pitiful of all are those several green-plumaged parrots with red beaks, taught so well by madam that they can sing along with the xiao flute. So pampered, so fond of being doted on, if feeding is delayed even briefly, they start to cry out your name in complaint. Now, call for them! Only the empty courtyard remains to answer you. ... Composed in January, 1925.

units.source_zh:
頂可憐是那幾個紅嘴綠毛的鸚哥，

讓娘娘教得頂乖，會跟著洞簫唱歌，

真嬌養慣，餵食一遲，就叫人名兒罵，

現在，您叫去！

ja.t: えてくれるのは、ただの

paragraphs.source_zh:
怨誰？怨誰？這不是青天裏打雷？

關著，鎖上；趕明兒瓷花磚上堆灰！

別瞧這白石台階兒光潤，趕明兒，唉，

石縫裏長草，石板上青青的全是霉！

那廊下的青玉缸裏養著魚真鳳尾，

可還有誰給換水，誰給撈草，誰給餵？

要不了三五天準翻著白肚鼓著眼，

不浮著死，也就讓冰分兒壓一個扁！

頂可憐是那幾個紅嘴綠毛的鸚哥，

讓娘娘教得頂乖，會跟著洞簫唱歌，

真嬌養慣，餵食一遲，就叫人名兒罵，

現在，您叫去！就剩空院子給您答話！……

一九二五年一月作
